Why Forgetting Matters?

Humans don’t remember everything — and that’s our strength. Forgetting helps us remove noise, adapt faster, and think creatively. But AI today remembers everything… and that might be its biggest flaw.

ForgetAI explores a new paradigm — where machines are not just intelligent, but selectively forgetful.
